cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

mechanism: Copy a referee's whistle as team play, then treat the penalties and lost captaincy as making a eventual trophy comeback more impressive.
confusable: Not future investment in learning: each reversal must increase the glory A imagines, while copied authority is the face-saving method.
comparison: Team discipline and a supporter role differ from a singer losing accompaniment.
seedUse: Retains repeated team losses as comeback story; replaces season/disbanding with two consequences of copied whistle use.
